next_actions: Run retrospective local validation without live clinician alerts.
Assess calibration, prevalence, alert burden, subgroups, and threshold transfer.

cohort_and_prevalence.description: Site-held-out retrospective validation on a geographically distinct public hospital cohort.

measurement_shift.finding: A care-process-only ablation (missingness and measurement frequency) reaches cross-validated utility 0.367 versus 0.413 for all features; physiology with trends reaches 0.258. Measurement patterns are site-specific and must be re-checked before any local use.

threshold_transfer.interpretation: High-risk utility transferred better than Watch sensitivity and alert burden. Calibration slope 0.80 on Dataset B means scores are somewhat too extreme at the new site; local recalibration is required.

limitations: A readiness recommendation is not regulatory or clinical approval.
Retrospective performance does not establish clinical outcome improvement.
Local silent/prospective evaluation is required before interruptive use.
